preserved.subject: Chemistry
preserved.question_a: A catalyst increases the rate of a reaction because it
preserved.answer_a: C — Provides an alternative pathway with lower activation energy.
preserved.question_b: Why does increasing temperature usually increase reaction rate?
preserved.answer_b: B — A greater fraction of particles has energy at least equal to activation energy.
preserved.reason: Catalysis lowers the activation energy through an alternative pathway; increasing temperature raises the fraction of particles able to overcome the activation energy. Different mechanisms.
